#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>
#include <bitset>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int p, k, ver[1001000], po[1001000];

int main() {
    int i, r = 1;
    //freopen("ttt", "r", stdin);

    cin >> p >> k;

    if(k == 0) {
        for(i = 1; i < p; ++i)
            r = (1LL * r * p) % MOD;
        cout << r;
        return 0;
    }
    if(k == 1) {
        for(i = 0; i < p; ++i)
            r = (1LL * r * p) % MOD;
        cout << r;
        return 0;
    }

    po[0] = 1;
    for(i = 1; i <= 1000000; ++i)
        po[i] = (1LL * po[i - 1] * k) % p;

    for(i = 1; i < p; ++i) if(!ver[i]) {
        int j = i, l = 0;

        do {
            ver[j] = 1;

            ++l;

            j = (1LL * k * j) % p;
        } while(!ver[j]);

        if(po[l] == 1)
            r = (1LL * r * p) % MOD;
        else {
            //r = (1LL * r * 2) % MOD;
        }

    }

    cout << r;

    return 0;
}
